item.title: Bukidnon State University graduate is lone 2025 bar topnotcher from Mindanao schools
item.description: Bukidnon State University College of Law Batch 2025 graduate Gerilin Ano-os Gascon posted an 89.79% rating, ranking 14th nationwide. Gascon, who is also a certified public accountant, is among the 5,594 examinees who passed the 2025 Bar Examinations out of 11,424 who completed the three-day tests, according to figures issued by the high court. Photo courtesy of the Bukidnon State University (BSU) Information Unit.
